test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

She was writing / a letter to her grandmother / when the power / gone out.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** i.e. **gone out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"gone out"** should be **corrected **to **"went out" **to maintain proper past tense agreement with the rest of the sent
